body.purpose: One engine on this machine the page mounts to over a socket, nothing polled: the stores attached read only, each renewed as its ref moves, the home a folder of the host’s own, the socket refused to any other origin and refusing attach; the tools unchanged. Read after by one Fable and one Opus, compared, and against the brief.
body.step: The one engine, its smallest step

name: The one engine, its smallest step

body.kept: Whole in the author's words: every utterance as it came, typed or spoken, the session's reading which; the typing's slips corrected on the word. His direction, written under the rule for another project and pasted here, kept as he gave it. After each, the essence of the session's answer in its own voice. The work stands in cfde5be, How the code is written; 8389ebb, the code made modules at the root with each store moved whole; ef74b65, the components made again from the root; and in the store's own commits.

name: A tenth session, kept whole: how the code is written, and the code made modules at the root
